# Vendored crates

The Sleigh crates this engine is built on, owned and built from this tree.
Each is a copy of its 0verflowme fork's `main` (which carries every change
below as a merged pull request), keeping only the files its own `include`
list packages; a refresh copies the fork again and re-applies the trims.

| Crate | Fork `main` | Upstream | Carried by the fork | Vendoring trims |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `libsla` 1.2.0 | 0verflowme/libsla `5edcac1d` | mnemonikr/libsla | user-operation names and the parser-cache reset (mnemonikr/libsla#18, #19); `GhidraSleigh` reads its address spaces once, a space's name is interned, and the p-code emit reads each varnode in place and its space from that list (ROADMAP PF1; #1) | the fork's `[patch]` to the other forks; the workspace's `[patch.crates-io]` stands in |
| `libsla-sys` 0.1.5 | 0verflowme/libsla-sys `44982342` (Ghidra 0verflowme/ghidra `6763e1ec`, `r2sleigh-sleigh-context` on `aed1cf1c`) | mnemonikr/libsla-sys | the same two passthroughs (mnemonikr/libsla-sys#8, #9); `getVarnodeSpace` and `getVarnodeOffset`, which read a varnode where `getAddress` allocated an `Address` (#1); Ghidra's include directory stated as `DEP_SLA_INCLUDE` (#2); Ghidra: `SleighBase` keeps the context fields `buildXrefs` found, `Sleigh` records whether a decode committed context and can mark its cached parses stale, and `clearCache` rebuilds the context only after a commit (ROADMAP PF0; #3); `cc`'s `parallel` feature (audit B1; #4) | Ghidra's decompiler C++ only, copied in place of the submodule; built at `opt-level = 3` in dev and release by the root `Cargo.toml`, as the spec compiler's build dependency too (audit B2) |
| `sleigh-compiler` 2.0.2 | 0verflowme/sleigh-compiler `4e380af4` | mnemonikr/sleigh-compiler | compiles against `DEP_SLA_INCLUDE`, `libsla-sys`'s Ghidra headers, since it links that `libsla` and must see the same class layouts (#1) | no Ghidra copy of its own: `DEP_SLA_INCLUDE` is required; built at `opt-level = 3` as a build dependency (audit B2) |
| `sleigh-config` 1.0.1 | 0verflowme/sleigh-config `760c9660` | mnemonikr/sleigh-config | each processor's files by name with its `.ldefs` and `.dwarf` (#1); Ghidra's Go compiler specifications corrected to Go's `abi-internal.md` (ROADMAP LP1; #2); AArch64 `addv` zeroes the vector above its byte result (#3); resynced from Ghidra master (918acd744d): `ldpsw`, `ldapr Xt`, `ldar Wt`, `stlrb`/`stlrh`, scalar `fmadd`/`fmsub` and the reductions' zero-fill (#4), `eor3`/`bcax`/`rax1`/`xar` (GP-7313; #10); W-form sign-extending loads (#5, the shape of Ghidra #6471 and #6447); W/H/B atomics, CAS, `ldapr`, `ldlar` and `swp` write the whole register and min/max compare at the access size (#6, Ghidra #9893); `mrs`/`msr nzcv` and `crc32`'s polynomial (#7, Ghidra #9895, #9896); `stlxp` at +8 (#8, Ghidra #9894); scalar FP rounding (#9, Ghidra #9897); specifications and tables `static` (audit B3; #11); one `sla-<stem>` feature per `.slaspec` beside the processor features (audit B4; #12) | only the x86, ARM, AARCH64, MIPS and RISCV processors, and only their `sla-<stem>` features (no processor feature), so the engine's 7 languages are the ones compiled |
